summary: Công cụ quản lý Docker hiện đại với giao diện web, giúp mọi người dùng dễ dàng quản lý container và docker compose
usecases: Simplify local Docker container management without relying on command-line
Enable self-hosted Docker dashboards for team collaboration and monitoring
Streamline testing and deployment of containerized applications
ideas: Integrate with cloud APIs for hybrid on-premise and cloud container management
Add resource usage analytics and performance visualizations for containers
Extend support for Kubernetes orchestration alongside Docker
